name: dollar-change-parameter
script: change "(a)(b)" into "[$2$1|$0|$$|${1}]" in "xaby" with regexp and dollar references

name: dollar-change-without
script: change "(a)(b)" into "[$2$1]" in "xaby" with regexp without dollar references

name: dollar-change-flag
script: change "(a)(b)" into "[$2$1]" in "xaby" with regexp regexpflag {"DOLLAR REFERENCES"}

name: dollar-change-named
script: change "(?<first>a)(b)" into "[${first}]" in "xaby" with regexp and dollar references

name: dollar-change-unknown-name
script: change "(a)" into "[${nope}]" in "xa" with regexp and dollar references

name: dollar-change-backslash-too
script: change "(a)" into "[\\1$1]" in "xa" with regexp and dollar references

name: dollar-change-literal-search
script: change "a" into "$0" in "xa" with dollar references

name: dollar-change-verbatim
script: change "(a)" into "$1" in "xa" with regexp, verbatim and dollar references

name: dollar-find-using
script: find text "([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)" in "x ab-12" using "$2:$1" with regexp, string result and dollar references

name: dollar-find-using-list
script: find text "([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)" in "x ab-12" using {"$2", "$1"} with regexp, string result and dollar references
